integrity: Proof, enumerators, assumptions, standalone independent distance-based exhaustive checker, comparison evidence, and explicit residual uncertainty are included. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact characterization is restricted to ordinary Mycielskians of simple cycles of order at least five. The full proof is mathematical; computational checks cover orders 5 to 9 exhaustively and selected local certificates at orders 10 to 15. Independent mathematical validation and global publication-priority clearance are not claimed.
title: Complete monitoring edge-geodetic sets of cycle Mycielskians
